definitions.explanation: The act or occasion of meeting someone, especially for the first time or by chance.

examples.japanese: {素敵|すてき}な{出会|であ}いがあった。
{人生|じんせい}を{変|か}える{出会|であ}いだった。
examples.english: It was an encounter that changed my life.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}との{出会|であ}いは{偶然|ぐうぜん}だった。
examples.english: My meeting with her was by chance.

notes:
FORMATION: Nominalized form of {出会|であ}う (to meet, to encounter).

KANJI VARIATIONS:
・{出会|であ}い - most common
・{出合|であ}い - alternative spelling

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{出会|であ}いがある (to have an encounter)
・{出会|であ}いを{求|もと}める (to seek encounters)
・{運命|うんめい}の{出会|であ}い (fateful encounter)
・{一期一会|いちごいちえ} (once-in-a-lifetime encounter - idiom)

USAGE NOTES: Often used in romantic or meaningful contexts, implying an encounter that has significance.

RELATED:
・{出会|であ}う (verb: to meet, to encounter)
・{出会|であ}い{系|けい} (dating site/app - modern usage)
